# SoloBookingLab

Independent decision support for solo and mobile service businesses (mobile dog groomers,
mobile car detailers, solo cleaners, driving instructors): choosing a booking stack for
scheduling, client intake, deposits, reminders and no-show protection without paying for
team features.

- Fit Finder: rule-based booking-stack recommendations with visible rules and labeled verification.
- Method & test protocol: published 9-step test all product claims must pass before we label them "verified by our own test".
- Verticals: mobile dog groomers, mobile car detailers (more planned, published only when verified).

Data rules: volatile facts carry vendor-source labels and verification dates; unverified points
are shown as unverified. Commission never affects recommendations; tools without affiliate
programs are included on merit. Publisher: William Robertsson, individual, Sweden.
Corrections: public via the repository issue tracker; log at /corrections.html.
